# Codex adapter — reading this file in the Codex harness

This file is compiled verbatim from CLAUDE.md by engine-sync codex build; Claude model aliases are already swapped to Codex models ({{index .Models "fable"}} = apex, {{index .Models "opus"}} = smart, {{index .Models "sonnet"}} = mechanical, {{index .Models "haiku"}} = collector). Where the text names Claude-harness mechanics, map them:

- Agent / Task spawn / `subagent_type` → `spawn_agent` with the matching `.codex/agents/*.toml` role
- AskUserQuestion → ask the founder in prose and end your turn
- Workflow() scripts → no equivalent: decompose sequentially or fan out `spawn_agent` calls
- Skills / slash commands → `.codex/skills/{name}/SKILL.md`, invoked as `$name` — Codex has no `/name` syntax, so every `/name` reference below is already rewritten to `$name` (nested Claude names flatten: `/flights:doctor` → `$flights-doctor`)
- Hooks → pfm's PreToolUse engine guard (`pfm internal engine-guard --engine codex`, in every Codex home's `hooks.json`) judges every shell and `apply_patch` call
- Git writes and framework files → Claude's alone: no Codex chat or role, gitter included, writes git (reads stay open) or changes a framework file (any `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.override.md` or `opencode.json(c)`, `.claude/`, `.codex/`, `.opencode/`, `.git/`, the Claude, Codex and OpenCode config dirs, the Professor clone's `templates/`). The engine guard denies each; a denial means return the exact change to the user, never a route around it.

# OpenCode adapter — reading this file in the OpenCode harness

The law above binds an OpenCode session identically. Model aliases were already swapped for the Codex host (the Codex adapter above names each tier's model); treat those as TIER LABELS here — each `.opencode/agent/*.md` pins its own OpenCode model for its tier. Mechanics:

- Agent / Task spawn / `subagent_type` → dispatch to the matching `.opencode/agent/*.md` role
- AskUserQuestion → ask the user in prose and end your turn
- Workflow() scripts → no equivalent: decompose sequentially
- Skills / slash commands → `.opencode/command/*.md`, invoked as `/flat-name` — nested Claude names are flattened (`/flights:doctor` → `/flights-doctor`); repo skills compile into `.opencode/skills/`
- Generated files → `.opencode/opencode.jsonc` `permission.edit` DENIES `AGENTS.md` and `.opencode/**`, and pfm's engine-guard plugin (`plugins/pfm-engine-guard.js` in the OpenCode config dir) judges every bash, edit, write and apply_patch call
- Git writes and framework files → Claude's alone, as the Codex adapter states: no OpenCode agent, gitter included, writes either; the engine guard denies each, and a denial means return the exact change to the user.
